records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Glad to have Quartz Partners on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project reached 7/18, but no invite, no replies to either outreach (email:0b3b4792, email:5387d0e0), no tickets, and key_milestone still unreached at day 6 with 8 days left. Silent, single-admin Starter accounts rarely self-activate in that window.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting Quartz Partners moving in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Nice work getting your first project created. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next bit of value usually comes from putting a real piece of work in one and bringing a colleague alongside you -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your next step with you and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Priya
